reference.source: package/dist/antd.min.js; runtime CSS-in-JS only; frame inherits the same global design-token typography/color as the native provider
reference.operation: capture all five Skeleton primitives, size context, shapes/block, CSS tokens/aliases, semantic style precedence and local prefixes
reference.nativeBoundary: Skeleton primitives preserve the source structure and settings. Named Svelte exports alias the static properties. Reduced motion additionally disables the placeholder animation. Main Skeleton retains its native host, busy/status, focus, layout guards and normalization; main semantic/config/prefix/ref APIs are a separate stage. Private hash/marker classes are excluded.
